content.comment_body: I am looking to build a two-point heating control system with a 0-10V output, aiming to manage a 0-10V valve for water. The idea is to use both outdoor temperature and flow water temperature sensors to regulate the valve, so the water heats up when the outdoor temperature falls. The weather-dependent setup uses external and supply water sensors to drive a 0-10V output, ensuring the mixing valve keeps a stable supply water temperature. I want to incorporate an adjustable heating curve, functioning like a two-point control but with a 0-10V analog output.
Hello, consider checking out: [article_no] compensated heating control.
